description: Defines interfaces and classes for E2 message handling, event management, connection management, and E2 agent control within the ocudu namespace, including message handlers, event handlers, connection procedures, and the E2 agent lifecycle.

classes.name: e2_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling incoming E2 messages.

classes.name: e2_event_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling E2 events such as connection loss.

classes.name: e2_message_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying reception of new E2 messages.

classes.name: e2_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing E2 connection procedures, including setup and disconnection.

classes.name: e2_interface
classes.description: Combined interface for E2 message handling, event handling, and connection management.

classes.name: e2ap_e2agent_notifier
classes.description: Notifier interface for E2 agent events, such as disconnection.

classes.name: e2_agent
classes.description: Public interface for an E2 agent, managing connection lifecycle and providing access to the E2 interface.
